name: Buraydah
registryBasis: The official Qassim regional municipality site documents Buraidah under regional urban-scale mapping, and its 2024 annual report search result documents construction of a geographic explorer for Buraidah. The Ministry of Municipalities and Housing officially describes U Maps as covering Saudi cities and displaying land plots. These establish official municipal/national parcel-map custodians, but not anonymous parcel access at the unchanged WUP point.

queries.query: Buraydah Saudi Arabia official urban maps land plots Ministry Municipalities Housing GIS Balady cadastral
queries.result: Found official Ministry Urban Maps documentation stating that U Maps covers all Saudi cities and displays streets, land plots, land-use classifications, plot sizes and building regulations; found official Qassim material identifying Buraidah in urban-scale mapping and an annual-report result describing a Buraidah geographic explorer. No public anonymous parcel feature schema or polygon response was exposed.

queries.query: بريدة الخرائط الحضرية قطع الأراضي أمانة القصيم بلدي خريطة
queries.result: Found the official Arabic Urban Maps service description: select U Maps in Balady, view Saudi map layers including streets and land plots, and select a map feature for details. The official Qassim annual-report result documents a Buraidah geographic explorer. No anonymous parcel feature schema or polygon response was exposed.

source.name: Saudi U Maps / Qassim Municipality Buraidah geographic mapping

viewerAndServiceTrace.notes: Current JavaScript configuration was inspected from the public viewer. The app requires its custom authentication path before loading configs. Direct anonymous GETs to the four API roots returned HTTP 404 with empty bodies; /portal/ redirected to /portal/home and returned portal HTML. No login, token, credentials, CAPTCHA or private field was requested.

geometryDecision.decision: No safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained. No sample GeoJSON retained.

scopeLimits.pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 settlement centroid; not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.

technicalBlocker: Official U Maps advertises land-plot coverage, but the current public app configuration disallows anonymous access and the inspected API roots did not yield a public feature service. Qassim/Buraidah mapping evidence does not expose a safe ID-and-geometry contract.
remainingUncertainty: A permitted authenticated workflow or a different current anonymous Qassim/Buraidah endpoint may expose parcel polygons; this attempt did not test credentials or private access and does not treat the failure as citywide absence.
